stem.text: Which description of multiple drug resistance in bacteria is correct?

A.text: Bacteria have DNA with resistant genes for several different types of antibiotic.

B.text: Different species of bacteria have DNA with resistant genes for one type of antibiotic.

C.text: Large numbers of one species of bacteria are immune to several different types of antibiotic.

D.text: Many different species of bacteria are immune to one type of antibiotic.
